summary: Backend API plan for stock K-line data query with daily/weekly/monthly aggregation, MACD/KDJ/BOLL indicator calculation via indicators.py, and chip distribution endpoint via DataFetcherManager.
approach: Follow existing FastAPI patterns: create Pydantic schemas (kline.py), implement service layer with pandas resample for period aggregation + indicator.py reuse (KlineService), expose two endpoints under /api/v1/kline/ prefix. Chip distribution uses external DataFetcherManager with circuit breaker. Tasks proceed schema-first, then service layer, then endpoints, then router registration.

design_decisions.rationale: Daily data already converted to DataFrame for indicator calculation; resample is idiomatic and correct for financial OHLCV data
design_decisions.tradeoff: Requires loading all daily data into memory before aggregation

design_decisions.decision: Reuse indicators.py functions directly in service layer
design_decisions.rationale: calc_macd/calc_kdj/calc_boll already handle DataFrame input/output with proper validation
design_decisions.tradeoff: Tight coupling to indicators.py column naming conventions (macd_dif, kdj_k, etc.)

design_decisions.decision: Chip distribution as separate endpoint using external API
design_decisions.rationale: Chip data not stored in stock_daily table; DataFetcherManager already has circuit breaker protection
design_decisions.tradeoff: External dependency - endpoint may return 404 when external API unavailable

quality_check.cli_fallback: gemini/qwen unavailable (no API key / not installed)

completeness.notes: All requirements covered: K-line query, period aggregation, MACD/KDJ/BOLL, chip distribution

task_granularity.notes: Each task 20-40 min scope, 5 tasks total

convergence_criteria.notes: All criteria quantified and testable, no vague language

constraint_compliance.notes: Reuses indicators.py, follows FastAPI patterns, stock_daily data only (chip uses external)
